## What were you trying to do? / 你当时想完成什么？

Tell us the goal in your own words. No code review is needed. / 用自己的话描述目标即可，不需要审阅代码。

## Where did you get stuck? / 你在哪一步卡住了？

What did you see, and what did you expect to happen? / 你看到了什么？原本期待发生什么？

## What did you try? / 你尝试过什么？

Include the page, guide, example, or command you used. A screenshot is welcome. / 可以附上使用的页面、指南、示例或命令，也欢迎附截图。

## Environment (optional) / 环境（可选）

- OS:
- Browser:
- Godot / Node.js version (if you know it):

Please remove passwords, tokens, private project files, and other sensitive data before posting. / 发布前请删除密码、令牌、私人项目文件和其他敏感信息。
